title: paepalanthus tenuis
intro: Paepalanthus tenuis, commonly known as Pampa grass, is a type of plant species in the family Vochysiaceae. Research suggests that Pampa grass has various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents of Pampa grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
